product_one_liner.value: Druid AI is an enterprise platform for building and deploying AI agents that automate complex business processes.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes tailored pricing plans and requests a custom quote rather than publishing numerical prices.

named_customers.notes: All three appear in the company's customer-story section.

employee_band.notes: Based on a reported count of 223. Sources disagree: LinkedIn lists 51–200, while the careers page says over 190; the counts lack clear effective dates.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index contains product, industry-use-case and thought-leadership content, rather than two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes flow creation, AI knowledge-base tools and integration guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable careers listing shows Technical Consultant, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Druid; Azure OpenAI; OpenAI; Google Vertex AI; Mistral AI; Mesolitica (MaLLaM); AWS Bedrock
model_provider.notes: These are documented configurable generative-endpoint providers, not a single mandatory or default provider.

compliance_certs.notes: These are publicly displayed compliance claims; HIPAA and GDPR are not certification programs.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 16, 2025 Series C falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A third-party Account Executive posting in New York lists an expiry of November 14, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 2026 announcement introduced major voice, agent-interoperability, governance and evaluation capabilities.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying join or departure was verified within the requested window, and the available leadership material did not establish a complete dated roster.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce appears in connector documentation; a marketing-role posting requests experience with HubSpot or Salesforce. These are integration and hiring signals, not confirmation that both are deployed internally.
